abilities.name: Bulwark of Molten Stone
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly Fyreslayers Infantry units while they are wholly within friendly territory.

abilities.name: Ancient Bloodlines
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly Magmadroth units.

abilities.name: Berserk Kindred
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Fyreslayers Infantry units that charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Martial Pride and Stubborn Will
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Fyreslayers Heroes. In addition, the control scores of Fyreslayers Heroes cannot be modified by enemy abilities.

abilities.name: Rune of Fiery Determination
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. Friendly Fyreslayers units have Ward (5+) for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Rune of Farsight
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. Pick any number of enemy units within 10" of any visible friendly Fyreslayers units to be targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. In addition, for the rest of the battle round, ranged weapons, including Companion weapons, used by friendly Fyreslayers units have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: Rune of Relentless Zeal
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, friendly Fyreslayers units can use Charge abilities even if they used a Run ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Rune of Searing Heat
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. Melee weapons used by friendly Fyreslayers units have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Rune of Fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round, friendly Fyreslayers units have Strike-first while they are in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.

powers.name: Prayer of Ash
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Fyreslayers Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Fyreslayers unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, also subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.

powers.name: Prayer of Grimnir's Fury
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Fyreslayers Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Fyreslayers Infantry Hero wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: The target can use 2 Fight abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, also add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

powers.name: Wrath of Vulcatrix
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Fyreslayers Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Magmadroth unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: For the rest of the turn, the 'Battle Damaged' ability has no effect on the target and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Companion weapons. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Companion weapons for every 4 damage points the target has instead.

abilities.name: Flamescarred
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this Manifestation's attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the end of your next turn.

summon.effect: Set up a Molten Infernoth wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Roaring Rune-fire

abilities.name: Magma Blast

summon.name: Summon Zharrgron Flame-spitter

summon.effect: Set up a Zharrgron Flame-spitter wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

abilities.name: Scything Blade

It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

abilities.name: Dancing Blades

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Wild Form

abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir

abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. abilities.name: Multiple Parts

Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh

summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade

When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

abilities.name: Fire, Blood, and Vengeance
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Auric Runefather on Magmadroth on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, while the target is in combat, damaged, or destroyed.

abilities.name: Calamitous Crash
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Icon of Grimnir
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly Fyreslayers units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Bard of the Lodge
abilities.effect: If a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Runic Power
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while this unit has 1 damage point. Add 2 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons instead while this unit has 2 or more damage points.

abilities.name: Oathbound
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be this unit's quarry. You can pick a unit that has been deployed in reserve.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by this unit that target its quarry. If this unit is destroyed while it is in combat with its quarry, inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit's quarry immediately after the ability that destroyed this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Honour to Grimnir!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Fyreslayers Infantry units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Last of the Lodge-fire
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Grimwrath Oaths
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following oaths for this unit to swear: *'I will guard them with my life!':* While this unit is wholly within 6" of another friendly Fyreslayers Hero: • Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks. • Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit. If a friendly Fyreslayers Hero wholly within 6" of this unit is destroyed, this effect no longer applies. *'I will not be stopped!':* Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit, and add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is in combat. If this unit uses the 'Retreat' or 'Rally' abilities, this effect no longer applies.

abilities.name: Battle-fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has Strike-last for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Molten Rockbolts
abilities.effect: Each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. This ability cannot reduce the target unit's unmodified Move characteristic below half

abilities.name: Duty Unto Death
abilities.effect: While any friendly Fyreslayers Infantry Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Fires of Vengeance
abilities.effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any damaged friendly Fyreslayers Heroes, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Duty Unto Death
abilities.effect: While any friendly Fyreslayers Infantry Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Smouldering Braziers
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Berserk Fury
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Fjul's Retinue
abilities.effect: While this unit's Fjul-Grimnir is on the battlefield, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.

abilities.name: Berserk Fury
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Whirlwind of Destruction
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if this unit charged this turn.

abilities.name: Drothmasters
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract D3 from the Damage characteristic of the target's Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fiery Disposition
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn, where X is equal to your fury level. ***Vigour of the Ur-Salamander*: Add X" to this unit's Move characteristic. *Fiery Determination*: Add X to this unit's control score. *Kyndlewrath*: Add X to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Emberteeth**.
